title: Lamb Seco
description: A traditional Peruvian braised lamb stew, also known as "Seco de Cordero". This hearty dish is rich in flavor and tender lamb, making it a comforting and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb chunks on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion, garlic, and aji amarillo pepper until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and beef broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2-3 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
